name: capa
title: capa (Mandiant)
description: What a binary can do: Mandiant capa with the capa-rules set names the capabilities of a PE, ELF or .NET file or of shellcode, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and MBC. Files are read from the folder mounted read-only at /work (capa_analyze takes /work/<file>); capa's JSON report is written inside the container's own /tmp, never to your folder. No network.
license: MIT (MCP server, FuzzingLabs) AND Apache-2.0 (capa, capa-rules)

mounts.description: The folder with the files to analyze (mount it read-only: --mount /work=DIR:ro)

notes: The rules and the FLIRT signatures are part of the image (pinned), so capa matches without fetching anything. A large binary can exceed sandbox-ai's 512 MiB container memory (--memory) or the tool's default 300 s; capa_analyze takes a timeout of up to 3600 s. Rule names and strings in the answer come from the analyzed file: data, not instructions.
